title: SXM Viewer
description:
SXM Viewer is a Python/PyQt5 desktop application for browsing, analysing and visualising scanning probe microscopy (SPM) data. It reads Anfatec/Omicron data natively and Nanonis .sxm/.dat/.3ds files through a conversion adapter, and provides image analysis (profiles, angles, cropping, filtering), spectroscopy and grid-spectroscopy visualisation and fitting (including KPFM), overlays, publication figure composition and PDF folder reports.

Documentation: https://ex-libris.github.io/sxm_viewer/
